name: When should I consider replacing my double-hung windows?
description: Replace double-hung windows if you see drafts, condensation, damage, or rising energy bills. Older windows (15-20+ years) often benefit most from replacement.

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my double-hung windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your double-hung windows if you notice drafts, condensation between glass panes, difficulty operating them, or visible damage to the frames. An increase in your energy bills can also be a strong indicator of poor window performance. A key decision factor is to consider the age of your current windows; if they are older than 15-20 years, newer models offer significant advancements in insulation and energy efficiency, making replacement a worthwhile investment.
